description.value:
Trigger A PC enters the area

Effect With a flash of light, the area crackles with electricity, and it begins to rain. The triggering creature is dealt @Damage[(1d6+2)[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save). On a critical failure, that creature is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. The hazard then rolls initiative.

details.description: An unnatural magical storm appears in the area with a crack of thunder and lightning.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:13], @Check[nature|dc:13], @Check[occultism|dc:13], or @Check[religion|dc:13] (all trained) to overcome the magical anomaly, or @Check[athletics|dc:16], @Check[survival|dc:16], or @Check[thievery|dc:16] to destabilize the hazard's center point; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
details.routine: (3 actions) The hazard makes three ranged Strikes against PCs, selecting different targets if possible, beginning with those closest to the hazard's center.
